title: dog10k cohort genotyping pipeline — samplesheet schema
description: Schema for the samplesheet provided with params.high_pass_samplesheet and params.low_pass_samplesheet in 01_mapping/2_cohort_genotyping. Each row is one sample's already-mapped, merged, MarkDups/BQSR'd BAM, gVCF, and depth-stats file, as produced and materialized by 01_mapping/1_fetch_map (via analyses/00_fetch-raw-data/run_batched.sh). One row per sample — 1_fetch_map already merges multi-run samples before producing these files, so there is no run_id column here (contrast assets/schemas/schema_input.json in 1_fetch_map, which is per-run).

sample.errorMessage: Sample ID must be provided and cannot contain spaces.

bam.errorMessage: BAM file must be provided, cannot contain spaces, and must have extension '.bam'.

bai.errorMessage: BAM index must be provided, cannot contain spaces, and must have extension '.bam.bai'.

gvcf.errorMessage: gVCF file must be provided, cannot contain spaces, and must have extension '.g.vcf.gz'.

gvcf_tbi.errorMessage: gVCF index must be provided, cannot contain spaces, and must have extension '.g.vcf.gz.tbi'.

depth_stats.errorMessage: Depth-stats file must be provided, cannot contain spaces, and must have extension '.knownsites.depth.txt' (RUN_STATS' calc_effective_depth() output, see 1_fetch_map/process_definitions.nf).
